in_hindi.name: सद्री

in_pashto.name: سدري

in_english.name: Sadri
in_english.meaning: One who is devoid of knowledge

historical_references.reference: Sultan Sadr al-Din Muhammad Shah, also known as Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq, ruled the Delhi Sultanate from 1320 to 1351 AD. He is known for his ambitious plans, one of which was to move his capital from Delhi to Hosangabad, in the Deccan region. This venture failed due to logistical challenges.

Sheikh Sadruddin Auliya, a Sufi saint, was born in 1177 AD in Afghanistan. He spent most of his life in India, especially in the city of Delhi, and is considered to be one of the most significant figures of the Chishti Sufi order. He is particularly famous for his teachings on love and compassion.
